title: Retrieval-augmented systems can be dangerous medical communicators
authors: Lionel Wong; Ayman Ali; Raymond Xiong; Shannon Zeijang Shen; Yoon Kim; Monica Agrawal
why_relevant: Analyzes failure modes of RAG systems where retrieved content is technically accurate but pragmatically misleading, including decontextualization, omission of critical sources, and compliance with biased queries—relevant to reliability, context compliance, and evaluation under unreliable evidence.
